_note: Hand-written places. Positions are from memory and may be a street or two off; check before relying on them.

rome-it.name: Colosseum
rome-it.description: The largest amphitheatre of the Roman world. Go at opening time or late afternoon to avoid the worst queues.

rome-it.name: Roman Forum
rome-it.description: The ruined centre of ancient Rome, covered by the same ticket as the Colosseum.

rome-it.name: Pantheon
rome-it.description: A two-thousand-year-old temple with an open hole in its dome, still in use as a church.

rome-it.name: Trevi Fountain
rome-it.description: Rome's best-known baroque fountain. Quietest before breakfast.

rome-it.name: Vatican Museums
rome-it.description: The papal collections, ending in the Sistine Chapel. Book a timed ticket ahead.

rome-it.name: Trastevere
rome-it.description: A neighbourhood of narrow lanes across the Tiber, full of trattorias and bars.

bari-it.name: Basilica of San Nicola
bari-it.description: An eleventh-century church built to hold the relics of Saint Nicholas, and a place of pilgrimage ever since.

bari-it.name: Bari Vecchia
bari-it.description: The old town on its peninsula. Locals still make orecchiette pasta at tables in the street.

bari-it.name: Swabian Castle
bari-it.description: A moated fortress at the edge of the old town, rebuilt by Frederick II.

bari-it.name: Pane e Pomodoro beach
bari-it.description: The city beach: free, sandy and a short walk from the centre. People swim here from late spring to autumn.

bari-it.name: Lungomare Nazario Sauro
bari-it.description: A long seafront promenade lined with old street lamps, best around sunset.

florence-it.name: Florence Cathedral
florence-it.description: The Duomo, with Brunelleschi's brick dome. You can climb the dome with a timed ticket.

florence-it.name: Uffizi Gallery
florence-it.description: The great collection of Renaissance painting, including Botticelli's Birth of Venus.

florence-it.name: Ponte Vecchio
florence-it.description: A medieval bridge still lined with goldsmiths' shops.

florence-it.name: Piazzale Michelangelo
florence-it.description: A terrace above the river with the classic view over the city. Walk up for sunset.

seville-es.name: Royal Alcazar
seville-es.description: A palace in Moorish style with tiled halls and large gardens. Book ahead in high season.

seville-es.name: Seville Cathedral and Giralda
seville-es.description: One of the largest Gothic churches anywhere. The bell tower was once a minaret and can be climbed by ramp.

seville-es.name: Plaza de Espana
seville-es.description: A sweeping half-circle of brick and painted tiles beside Maria Luisa Park.

seville-es.name: Triana
seville-es.description: The old potters' and flamenco quarter across the river, with a covered market and many tapas bars.

seville-es.name: Metropol Parasol
seville-es.description: A huge wooden canopy with a rooftop walkway and views over the old town.

barcelona-es.name: Sagrada Familia
barcelona-es.description: Gaudi's unfinished basilica. Entry is by timed ticket and often sells out.

barcelona-es.name: Park Guell
barcelona-es.description: A hillside park of mosaic terraces and odd pavilions, with views to the sea.

barcelona-es.name: Gothic Quarter
barcelona-es.description: The medieval core of the city, around the cathedral.

barcelona-es.name: La Boqueria market
barcelona-es.description: The big covered food market off La Rambla. Go in the morning.

barcelona-es.name: Barceloneta beach
barcelona-es.description: The closest city beach, wide and busy, with a long promenade.

lisbon-pt.name: Belem Tower
lisbon-pt.description: A small sixteenth-century fortress on the river, from the age of Portuguese exploration.

lisbon-pt.name: Jeronimos Monastery
lisbon-pt.description: A richly carved monastery in the Manueline style. The famous custard tart bakery is next door.

lisbon-pt.name: Sao Jorge Castle
lisbon-pt.description: A hilltop castle above the Alfama quarter with wide views over the river.

lisbon-pt.name: Miradouro da Senhora do Monte
lisbon-pt.description: One of the highest viewpoints in the city, popular at sunset.

lisbon-pt.name: Time Out Market
lisbon-pt.description: A food hall in the old Ribeira market with stalls from well-known Lisbon kitchens.

lagos-pt.name: Ponta da Piedade
lagos-pt.description: A headland of golden cliffs, arches and sea caves. Walk the boardwalk or see it by kayak from below.

lagos-pt.name: Praia Dona Ana
lagos-pt.description: A sheltered cove under tall cliffs, within walking distance of town.

lagos-pt.name: Praia do Camilo
lagos-pt.description: A small beach reached by a long wooden staircase. It fills up early in summer.

lagos-pt.name: Meia Praia
lagos-pt.description: Several kilometres of open sand east of the harbour, with room even in August.

lagos-pt.name: Lagos old town
lagos-pt.description: Cobbled streets inside the old walls, with restaurants and a small fort by the water.

athens-gr.name: Acropolis
athens-gr.description: The rock above the city with the Parthenon on top. Go at opening time; there is little shade.

athens-gr.name: Acropolis Museum
athens-gr.description: A modern museum for the sculptures found on the Acropolis, built over an excavated neighbourhood.

athens-gr.name: Ancient Agora
athens-gr.description: The marketplace of classical Athens, with the well-preserved Temple of Hephaestus.

athens-gr.name: Plaka
athens-gr.description: The old quarter below the Acropolis, with stepped lanes and tavernas.

athens-gr.name: Mount Lycabettus
athens-gr.description: The highest hill in central Athens. Walk or take the funicular for the view.

heraklion-gr.name: Palace of Knossos
heraklion-gr.description: The largest Minoan palace, partly reconstructed, a short bus ride south of the city.

heraklion-gr.name: Heraklion Archaeological Museum
heraklion-gr.description: The best collection of Minoan art anywhere, including the frescoes from Knossos.

heraklion-gr.name: Koules Fortress
heraklion-gr.description: A Venetian sea fort at the mouth of the old harbour.

heraklion-gr.name: Ammoudara beach
heraklion-gr.description: A long sandy beach just west of the city.

dubrovnik-hr.name: City walls
dubrovnik-hr.description: A two-kilometre walk around the top of the old town's walls. Start early in summer.

dubrovnik-hr.name: Stradun
dubrovnik-hr.description: The polished limestone main street of the old town.

dubrovnik-hr.name: Mount Srd
dubrovnik-hr.description: The hill behind the city, reached by cable car or a steep path, with a view over the roofs and islands.

dubrovnik-hr.name: Banje beach
dubrovnik-hr.description: A pebble beach just outside the eastern gate, looking back at the walls.

dubrovnik-hr.name: Lokrum island
dubrovnik-hr.description: A wooded island fifteen minutes away by boat, with rocks for swimming and a small salt lake.

bergen-no.name: Bryggen
bergen-no.description: A row of wooden merchant houses on the old Hanseatic wharf.

bergen-no.name: Mount Floyen
bergen-no.description: A hilltop above the centre, reached by funicular, with forest trails behind it.

bergen-no.name: Fish Market
bergen-no.description: Seafood stalls on the harbour, indoors and out.

bergen-no.name: KODE art museums
bergen-no.description: Four buildings by the city lake with Norwegian art, including works by Munch.

bergen-no.name: Mount Ulriken
bergen-no.description: The highest of Bergen's seven mountains. A cable car runs up, and a ridge walk leads across to Floyen.

saint-malo-fr.name: Ramparts
saint-malo-fr.description: A walk around the top of the old town's granite walls, above the beaches.

saint-malo-fr.name: Fort National
saint-malo-fr.description: A seventeenth-century fort on a tidal rock, reached on foot at low tide.

saint-malo-fr.name: Grand Be
saint-malo-fr.description: A tidal island with a wide sea view. Check the tide times before crossing.

saint-malo-fr.name: Plage du Sillon
saint-malo-fr.description: A three-kilometre sandy beach along the sea wall.

istanbul-tr.name: Hagia Sophia
istanbul-tr.description: Built as a cathedral in the sixth century and now a mosque, with a vast dome.

istanbul-tr.name: Blue Mosque
istanbul-tr.description: The Sultan Ahmed Mosque, known for its blue tiles and six minarets.

istanbul-tr.name: Topkapi Palace
istanbul-tr.description: The palace of the Ottoman sultans, with courtyards, treasury and harem.

istanbul-tr.name: Grand Bazaar
istanbul-tr.description: One of the world's oldest covered markets, with thousands of small shops.

istanbul-tr.name: Galata Tower
istanbul-tr.description: A medieval stone tower across the Golden Horn with a viewing balcony.

istanbul-tr.name: Kadikoy market
istanbul-tr.description: Food streets on the Asian side, a short ferry ride away.

paris-fr.name: Eiffel Tower
paris-fr.description: The iron tower from 1889. Book a lift ticket ahead, or climb the stairs to the second floor.

paris-fr.name: Louvre
paris-fr.description: The largest art museum in the world. Choose a few sections; it can't be seen in a day.

paris-fr.name: Musee d'Orsay
paris-fr.description: Impressionist and nineteenth-century art in a former railway station.

paris-fr.name: Notre-Dame
paris-fr.description: The Gothic cathedral on an island in the Seine.

paris-fr.name: Montmartre and Sacre-Coeur
paris-fr.description: A hill of steep streets topped by a white basilica, with a view across the city.

paris-fr.name: Luxembourg Gardens
paris-fr.description: A formal park on the Left Bank with chairs around a pond.
